    // Deliberately NOT covered here: MortonCode2D/3D (spatial-structures) and

    //==
    // # IIndexable
    //
    // Endpoint access and bounds checking for a one-dimensional collection.

    // The index of the last element (Count - 1); negative when empty.
    LastIndex(self: IIndexable<$T>): Integer
        => self.Count - 1;
